rows.label: Mastery Rank 5
rows.note: to craft the Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment

conditions: The 10 codes used by the Upgrade Segment are consumed; they do not count toward the 10 needed to incubate a kavat.
The first Incubator Power Core comes from the Venus-to-Mercury Junction. Later attempts consume another crafted core.

rows.label: Cross-Matrix Widget
rows.note: 45% chance for each scan to count twice

conditions: Codes only come from scans that land while the Feral Kavat is alive. Corpse scans grant Simaris standing, never codes.
Horend is the quick repeat: scan the opening packs, complete Capture and extract. Phlegyas and Formido are valid Deimos alternatives; Terrorem can be camped for recurring packs.
Pack size is squad size plus one, but codes are personal: in a squad every player must scan every cat themselves.
Do not use ragdolls or wide-area kills. The cats are neutral, cloaked and fragile; sleep, slow, invisibility or Limbo Stasis preserves them for scans.
bonuses: A full squad increases each pack to five cats. Cross-Matrix is the largest quality-of-life improvement before beginning the farm.
Dante's Noctua kill-scans without the normal Codex-completion limitation; direct-hit kills only.
If Sands of Inaros is unfinished, its second stage is a one-time cache of up to 50 safe Feral Kavats. Bring scanners and prepare before completing it.

disclosures.title: the 20-code floor is not a Smeeta guarantee
disclosures.body: Twenty codes only unlock one Random Incubation after building the segment. Random incubation can produce Adarza instead, requiring another 10 codes and another Power Core for every retry. The commonly quoted 50/50 breed split is not officially quantified.

conditions: The blueprint comes from Tenno Lab research; Hyekka Masters, including Spear on Mars, can also drop it.
The segment has one additional rare-component requirement. Check the Foundry recipe before committing the final codes.
bonuses: A built segment is also sold in the Market for 175 platinum.

conditions: The reusable blueprint costs 50,000 credits in the Market. Do not spend resources building a core if the Junction freebie is still available.
A wrong Random Incubation result consumes another core as well as another 10 codes.

rows.label: Smeeta Kavat
rows.alt: use two Smeeta Genetic Code Templates

conditions: Random Incubation cannot be directed to Smeeta. An Adarza result has no pity protection and starts another 10-code attempt.
Two matching Smeeta imprints replace the breed roulette but do not replace the 10 codes or Power Core.
Incubation is 48 hours, or 24 hours with the separate Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment; rushing costs 15 platinum.
bonuses: Smeeta imprints are tradeable. A mature kavat can make three, and each template has a reusable 50,000-credit blueprint with a 6-hour build time.

disclosures.title: better escape hatch than more code farming
disclosures.body: If the goal is specifically Smeeta, buying or borrowing two Smeeta Genetic Code Templates controls the breed. It is usually less punishing than repeatedly farming codes and waiting through 48-hour random incubations; still budget the full materials for the one imprint incubation.
